name: PopFestive
tagline: AI Christmas photos and videos from one picture
description: PopFestive puts your family and pets into festive scenes. Upload a photo and pick a Christmas effect: Christmas PFP (Santa hat, anime, 3D cartoon, cozy and winter-wonderland styles), Add Christmas decor, Santa Nice List certificate, Photo with Santa, Santa Caught on Camera, Christmas pets (one or two pets in one portrait), a baby-riding-reindeer video, and Santa camera video. Most effects need just one photo. It runs in the browser, no app needed, with square avatar and vertical formats for social sharing. Creations use credits; see the pricing page for packs and optional plans. Failed creations are never charged.
